items.title: Mrs. Arnold Metoyer Interview, 1960-10-19
items.q: And this is my brother, which is his son. That's my oldest brother.

ctx.x: And he played, too, you see? He played music?

No, he played cornet. His mother, this old lady, played guitar. Oh, I knew it was the guitar. He told her he had some corrections to me. This is his grandmother. My father's, in other words, this is his mother. And this is his son. And this is my brother, which is his son. That's my oldest brother.
That's your oldest brother, little baby.
